gloss: to devote oneself; to dedicate oneself

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself; to dedicate oneself (to a cause or pursuit)
definitions.explanation: To commit one's entire being to a purpose, cause, or activity, often at the expense of personal comfort or desires.

definitions.gloss: to sacrifice oneself; to give one's life
definitions.explanation: To give up one's life or safety for a cause, person, or ideal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げてきた。
examples.english: She has devoted herself to music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げた⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a doctor who devoted himself to the advancement of medicine.
They sacrificed themselves for their country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I am prepared to sacrifice myself to protect my comrades.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げた{人|ひと}々⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must not forget the sacrifice of those who gave their lives for peace.

notes:
{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる literally means "to offer one's body/self" (⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ = body/self, ⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧ = to offer/dedicate). It is a literary and somewhat elevated expression conveying deep commitment or sacrifice.

USAGE:
The cause or pursuit is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる. Sense 1 (devotion) is more common in modern usage than sense 2 (sacrifice).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる: devote oneself to one's work
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる: devote oneself to love
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる: dedicate oneself to God
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる: sacrifice oneself for one's country

- ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧: to devote one's whole life — emphasizes the lifetime duration
- ⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}む→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧: to devote oneself to; to throw oneself into — more colloquial and active
- ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧: to serve; to exhaust oneself for — focuses on giving one's all in service
